description_en: Closes a connection based on the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) app instance ID and username
description_zh: 根据智能接入网关APP实例ID和用户名，剔除在线连接
kebab_example: aliyun smartag kick-out-clients --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-ehjfb0000000 --username doctest --region cn-hangzhou
name: KickOutClients

parameters.help_en: The region where the SAG APP instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关APP实例所在的地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG APP instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en:
The username of the client account. Usernames of client accounts added to the same SAG APP instance are unique.

For a client account, if you specify the username, you must also specify the password
parameters.help_zh:
用户名，同一个智能接入网关APP实例下的用户名不可以重复。

用户名和密码相互依赖，若指定用户名则必须指定密码，反之，若指定密码则必须指定用户名
parameters.name: username
